method.source_verification: git -C /tmp/tlsn-phase0-alpha15 rev-parse HEAD && sha256sum Cargo.toml Cargo.lock
method.candidate_comparison: git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout https://github.com/tlsnotary/tlsn.git /tmp/tlsn-candidate-repo; compare refs/tags/v0.1.0-alpha.15 and refs/remotes/origin/main
method.api_test: cargo test -p tlsn-attestation --features fixtures --test api test_api -- --exact
method.fixture_extraction: Deserialize crates/attestation/tests/fixtures/presentation.bin as Presentation, verify with CryptoProvider::default(), extract attestation.header.id.0, and compare the golden values in tlsn-alpha15-adoption-profile-v1.json
method.repository_inventory: rg --files and rg searches excluding target and node_modules
method.secret_policy: credential、cookie、Bearer token、private key、production identifier、live identity dataは収集していない。

evidence_policy.natural_source: ordinary FUSOU-APP startup and gameplay through the supported Game Client and an allowlisted Game Server
prohibited_sources: retry of a forwarded logical request
evidence_policy.capture_behavior: passive observation of an existing client-facing TLS plaintext session; the capture harness never creates the request
evidence_policy.natural_collection: manual controlled observation with private raw storage, provenance record, and privacy review
evidence_policy.ci_policy: CI may validate synthetic harness artifacts and previously sanitized fixtures, but cannot create or auto-pass natural provenance
evidence_policy.repository_fact: The normal APP path starts the proxy and PAC routing before opening the Game Client, but the repository does not identify the exact ordinary gameplay action that first causes require_info

gates.reason: the documentation-only Phase 0 acceptance is satisfied by an explicitly selected release commit, reproducible upstream Cargo.lock and manifest fingerprints, and a scoped license/security review with distribution constraints; no FUSOU runtime dependency is claimed
gates.specification_impact: alpha.15のexact revision、upstream dependency boundary、license/security disposition、adapter ownershipをimplementation inputとして凍結する
gates.implementation_impact: runtime implementationは開始しない。後続実装はprofile artifactのrevision/lockから逸脱せず、法務確認なしのbinary redistributionを行わない
gates.finding: Phase 0のP0-A acceptanceをdocumentation-only selection/profile freezeとして適用した。alpha.15 (`47aee45b53e06648c1b2ad3689b367b8c923fdec`)、upstream Cargo.lock SHA-256、selected package manifest SHA-256、MIT/Apache metadata、tlsn-attestationのlicense metadata欠落、root LICENSE/NOTICE/SECURITY不在、およびFUSOU direct dependency未導入を [tlsn-alpha15-adoption-profile-v1.json](tlsn-alpha15-adoption-profile-v1.json) に固定した。PASSはruntime integrationまたはredistribution authorizationを意味しない。
gates.next_action: runtime implementation開始時にのみ、選定profileのlockをFUSOU dependencyへ導入し、法務owner確認と再現可能なdependency reviewを完了する。

gates.reason: the selected alpha.15 revision exposes a verified public extraction path and the opaque-byte encoding, fixture hash, ID values, and BCS Header signing preimage are frozen
gates.specification_impact: verified Presentationから抽出するraw 16-byte ID、strict unpadded base64url transport、raw database representation、ClaimBinding length prefixを凍結する
gates.implementation_impact: runtime実装は開始しない。後続実装はPresentation verification成功後だけIDを抽出し、Header全体のBCS署名境界をID単体の署名と誤認しない
gates.finding: selected alpha.15のextraction expressionは `presentation.verify(&CryptoProvider::default())?.attestation.header.id.0`。`Uid(pub [u8; 16])`のexact raw bytesをopaque IDとし、fixture `presentation.bin`（5394 bytes、SHA-256 `cb9b3befb43df5157a4d5ac52080ba19d842f191fa346bfda1dfc4927b37e5b6`）からID hex `effe1a316b1c91b41f6284f78409c6c2`、base64url `7_4aMWsckbQfYoT3hAnGwg`、54-byte Header BCS goldenを得た。
gates.next_action: runtime implementation時にこのprofileをRust/TypeScript fixtureへ移し、cross-language Result/ClaimBinding equalityとnegative casesをP0-10で検証する。

gates.reason: security review establishes that Notary issuance-time provenance is not required for the v1 Primary Security Goal; Claim authorization freshness is bounded by server-issued Session/Challenge/device lifecycle
gates.specification_impact: M (Notary issuance-time provenance) をv1から削除し、L (Claim authorization freshness) をserver-side v_db_now、Session/Challenge/device TTL、single-useで境界付ける。ConnectionInfo.timeとclient/verifier clockはauthorityにしない
gates.implementation_impact: stale/future proof fixtureを含むcontract testsを実装するが、Notary timestamp authorityや外部timestamp serviceは追加しない
gates.finding: 候補にはNotary-issuedなnotary_time fieldがない。ConnectionInfo.timeはTLS connection-start metadataであり、v1のidentity authorityではない。古いproofを未期限Session/Challengeへ遅延送信する場合に失われるのはproof ageの証明だけで、response provenance、Proof Copy拒否、replay防止、owner conflict、live authorizationは失われない。
gates.next_action: A-M security review、stale/future proof negative cases、Session/Challenge TTLとserver-side v_db_nowのboundary fixtureをP0-B evidenceとして保持する。

gates.reason: the reviewed supported-client exact-wire require_info capture, natural provenance record, and allowlisted Game Server identity pass; privacy and operational qualification remain separate
gates.specification_impact: synthetic harness correctnessとnatural client provenanceを別証拠として扱い、standalone request、injection、replay、capture-generated trafficをnatural evidenceとして認めない
gates.implementation_impact: synthetic harnessの実装・検証は独立して許可する。P0-04のnatural evidenceはpassしたが、P0-05 authenticated disclosure、P0-15 privacy review、その他のruntime gatesは別途承認されていない
gates.finding: 旧evidence-attemptでは自然captureを取得していなかったが、その後の既存private artifact reviewで、supported Game Clientの通常gameplayに由来するexact-wire POST /kcsapi/api_get_member/require_info、HTTP 200 response、allowlisted Game Server identity、artifact hash、Number token/framing/compression/response-size manifest、passive observation recordを確認した。旧BLOCKED判定はprivacy_qualifiedをP0-04へ誤って結合していたため superseded とする。無関係なFUSOU-APP upload/retry side effectはprivacy/operational caveatであり、require_infoのnatural provenanceを無効にしない。詳細は [tlsn-natural-capture-forensic-review-2026-09-05.md](tlsn-natural-capture-forensic-review-2026-09-05.md) に固定した。
natural_evidence_conditions: raw bytes and message boundaries preserved
privacy review recorded separately; privacy qualification is not a P0-04 prerequisite
manual evidence; not auto-passed by CI
gates.next_action: P0-04は補正後のnatural evidenceでPASSとする。P0-05 authenticated disclosure、P0-15 privacy/non-persistence/redaction review、runtime gatesは未完了のまま維持する。

gates.finding: alpha.15 upstream Presentation fixtureのverification成功はP0-02の証拠に限られ、FUSOU require_infoのauthenticated request/response disclosure、server identity、binding header、range、digest、strict parser negative casesを証明しない。Dedicated Verifier、accepted full request/response presentation、disclosure range fixture、digest golden、privacy review inputはrepositoryに存在しない。詳細は [tlsn-p0-04-p0-05-evidence-attempt-v1.json](tlsn-p0-04-p0-05-evidence-attempt-v1.json) に固定した。
gates.next_action: 自然capture取得後にのみ、選定alpha.15 adapter境界でfull request/response disclosure、strict framing/range/digest validation、binding header検証、negative matrix、privacy reviewを実証する。自然captureの存在だけでP0-05をPASSにしてはならない。
